MIZORAM PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
COMPETITIVE EXAMINATIONS FOR RECRUITMENT TO THE POST OF
JUNIOR GRADE OF MAH & VS I.E. VETERINARY OFFICER UNDER ANIMAL HUSBANDRY
AND VETERINARY DEPARTMENT.
NOVEMBER, 2019
GENERAL ENGLISH PAPER - II
Time Allowed : 2 hours
Full Marks : 100
All questions carry equal marks of 1 each.
Attempt all questions.
Directions (Questions 1 - 10) : Identify the parts of speech of the underlined words.
1. Let us first better our financial position.
(a) Verb
(b) Adverb
(c) Noun
(d) Adjective
2. You are working better today.
(a) Verb
(b) Adverb
(c) Noun
(d) Adjective
3. I do not like the cut of your hair.
(a) Verb
(b) Adverb
(c) Noun
(d) Adjective
4. Cut the paper in desired sizes.
(a) Verb
(b) Adverb
(c) Noun
(d) Adjective
5. The man was thrown from the down train.
(a) Adverb
(b) Preposition
(c) Noun
(d) Adjective
6. The engine came rushing down the hill very fast.
(a) Adverb
(b) Preposition
(c) Noun
(d) Adjective
7. He brought something else for her.
(a) Noun
(b) Adjective
(c) Conjunction
(d) Preposition
8. Walk fast else you should miss the bus.
(a) Noun
(b) Adjective
(c) Conjunction
(d) Preposition
9. She won’t be happy with less.
(a) Noun
(b) Adjective
(c) Verb
(d) Adverb
10. The soil of her garden is less fertile than mine.
(a) Noun
(b) Adjective
(c) Verb
(d) Adverb

Directions (Questions 11-20): Fill in the blanks with the appropriate prepositions.
11. He will abide _____ his friend in all circumstances.
(a) at
(b) in
(c) by
(d) with
12. He is angry _____ your laughing at his wife.
(a) at
(b) with
(c) for
(d) to
13. Quinine is an antidote _____ malaria.
(a) to
(b) against
(c) for
(d) of
14. His wife was an accomplice _____ the murder.
(a) in
(b) of
(c) over
(d) with
15. He has a great antipathy _____ wine.
(a) to
(b) against
(c) with
(d) for
16. She takes full care _____ her clothes and make-up.
(a) for
(b) about
(c) of
(d) with
17. After marriage I enter _____ a new way of life.
(a) into
(b) at
(c) by
(d) upon
18. She grieved _____ my unfortunate loss.
(a) for
(b) at
(c) over
(d) about
19. He was greatly moved _____ the sight of her dead body.
(a) with
(b) from
(c) to
(d) at
20. I parted _____ my wife in the park.
(a) from
(b) with
(c) over
(d) by

(b) Adjective of quantity

(b) Adjective of quantity

Directions (Questions 31-40): Choose the correct modal to fill in the blanks.
31. When he was young, he _____ swim very well.
(a) had to
(b) can
(c) could
(d) would
32. The company _____ go bankrupt if they don’t find a lot of money quickly.
(a) should
(b) would
(c) can
(d) might
33. She _____ be more than thirsty, she looks so young.
(a) may
(b) cannot
(c) could
(d) must
34. She look beautiful, she _____ be a model.
(a) should
(b) would
(c) could
(d) will
35. How _____ I contact you?
(a) can
(b) may
(c) could
(d) must
36. You _____ write her a letter.
(a) can
(b) may
(c) could
(d) should
37. _____ I have more cheese on my sandwich?
(a) would
(b) must
(c) could
(d) should

38. The passengers _____ wear their seat belts at all times.
(a) may
(b) must
(c) could
(d) can
39. We _____ go to the concert if the rain stops.
(a) can
(b) would
(c) might
(d) will
40. I _____ like to buy the same television for my house.
(a) would
(b) could
(c) should
(d) may

61. It is no use crying over spilt milk.

(b) Negative
(c) Affirmative
(d) Assertive

Directions (Questions 71-80): Substitute the underlined phrases to improve the sentences if
necessary.
71. He will be greatly surprised if he was felicitated by his staff members.
(a) if he will have felicitated
(b) unless he was felicitated
(c) if he is felicitated
(d) No improvement
72. Newton wanted to know why did the apple fall to the ground.
(a) Know that why did the apple fall
(b) Know why the apple fell
(c) Know that why the apple fell
(d) No improvement
73. He was extremely unhappy because of the inordinately delay.
(a) the inordinate delaying
(b) the inordinate delay
(c) the inordinately delaying
(d) No improvement
74. There is no more room for you in this compartment.
(a) There is no more accommodation
(b) There is no more space
(c) There is no more seat
(d) No improvement
75. Each of our students pay their tuition fee at the beginning of the month.
(a) student pay their
(b) students pays their
(c) students pays his
(d) No improvement
76. I told him clearly that he hadn’t ought to do that to me.
(a) ought not to have done
(b) ought not done
(c) ought not has done
(d) No improvement

- 7 -
77. I took the cycle which he has bought yesterday.
(a) that he bought yesterday
(b) that he had bought yesterday
(c) that which he had bought yesterday
(d) No improvement
78. The climate of Delhi is somewhat like Jaipur.
(a) like Jaipur’s
(b) as Jaipur’s
(c) as Jaipur
(d) No improvement
79. Now I must beg leave of you.
(a) beg you leave
(b) beg of your leave
(c) beg off your leave
(d) No improvement
80. The two thieves distributed the loot between themselves.
(a) among themselves
(b) amongst themselves
(c) with themselves
(d) No improvement
Directions (Questions 81-90): Give one word for the following expressions/sentences.
81. A small shop that sells fashionable clothes, cosmetics, etc.
(a) Store
(b) Stall
(c) Boutique
(d) Couture
82. The order to stay in one’s own bailiwick means that a person should remain in his own-

(b) district
(c) country
(d) bed

(b) Stoic
(c) Purist
(d) Misogynist

(d) Plagiarism
85. One who hates learning.

(b) Misogamist

(a) bombastic
(b) untruthful

(d) vituperative

(b) Pedantic
(c) Pathology
(d) Pangram
88. An established principle.

(b) Malins
(c) Manuscript
(d) Pangram

(a) Hydrophobia
(b) Amnesia
(c) Kleptomania

(b) gallery
(c) chain
(d) group

(c) paint
(d) shade

(b) Begin
(c) Propel
(d) Push

(c) Alchemy
(d) Geology
